newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan OKs foreign non-corporate funds in stocks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan OKs foreign non-corporate funds in stocks.

text.p: Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission said on Tuesday it has decided to allow foreign non-corporate funds to enter the domestic stock market, effective immediately.

"These non-corporate foreign funds will be from now on be seen as qualified foreign institutions, each of which can apply for up to US$600 million for investment in Taiwan stocks," a commisison spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.
In the past, these non-corporate foreign funds had to buy foreign corporate funds to indirectly enter the Taiwan stock market, the spokeswoman said.
In late 1996, Taiwan raised the combined ceiling for investments by foreigners and foreign institutions to 25 percent of the total market value from 20 percent.
